comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Editor support for attribute declarations
themes.text: The editor colours, completes and outlines an attribute declaration the same way it does a class. Go to definition, rename and signature help also work for its fields.

themes.title: Faster checks in the editor after an edit
themes.text: After you edit a file, the editor checks again only the files that use what you changed. An edit inside a method body checks no other file.
